evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The directive appeals to stability through recurring rehearsal and frames rehearsal as the condition of having a capable rollback.
The cadence explicitly carries a preservation-oriented routine and a mastery-oriented practice.
Naming an owner directly foregrounds accountable capability for the practice.

mints.name: RehearsedCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have rehearsed is a rollback we do actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression make demonstrated rehearsal the test of whether capability is real?
